DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入浴の前に、ご不明なことはありますか。お荷物の整理もこちらでできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you're unsure about before bathing? You can organize your belongings here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋からタオルは持ってきましたが、大きい物と小さい物のどちらを浴室へ持つのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参した大小二枚のタオルのどちらを浴室へ持つか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought towels from my room, but I'm not sure whether to take the large one or the small one into the bathing area.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which of the two towels you brought, large or small, to take into the bathing area. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの掲示では、体を拭く大きなタオルは脱衣所で使う物と案内しています。浴室へ持ち込む物も分けて読めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: This notice says the large towel for drying your body is used in the changing room. You can read separately what to bring into the bathing area.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きいほうは脱衣所に残すのですね。小さいタオルもお湯の中には入れないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大きいタオルは脱衣所に残し小さい物も浴槽のお湯へ入れないと理解を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I leave the large one in the changing room. I'll also make sure not to put the small towel in the bathwater.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand that the large towel stays in the changing room and the small one must not go in the bathwater either. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、掲示のその部分をご覧ください。携帯電話をお持ちなら、浴室へ入る前に収納してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, please look at that part of the notice. If you have a mobile phone, please put it away before entering the bathing area.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話はかばんにしまいます。入口で連れに写真を送ろうとしていましたが、ここでは出さないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 携帯を収納し連れへの写真送信のためここで出す予定をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put my phone in my bag. I was going to send my companion a photo at the entrance, but I won't take it out here.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put your phone away and give up your plan to take it out here to send your companion a photo. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影についても入口に表示しています。お連れの方とは、出た後にどこで会う予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: The entrance also has a sign about photography. Where are you planning to meet your companion after you come out?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出た後の場所を決めていませんでした。連れに話して、休憩スペースの時計の下で会うことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未決定だった入浴後の待合せを連れに伝えて休憩所時計下に決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: We hadn't decided where to meet afterward. I'll talk to them and arrange to meet under the clock in the rest area.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your companion about the previously undecided meeting after bathing and choose under the rest-area clock. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 待ち合わせを先に決めておくと、浴室で電話を使わずに済みますね。タオルの準備はできそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you decide where to meet first, you won't need to use the phone in the bathing area. Do you think you can get your towels ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 大きいタオルと電話は外に残し、小さいタオルだけ持つ形にします。先に連れと待合せ場所を話してきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外に残すタオルと電話を区別し入浴前に連れと集合場所を話すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave the large towel and phone outside and take only the small towel in. I'll go and discuss the meeting place with my companion first.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the towel and phone to leave outside, and say you will discuss the meeting place with your companion before bathing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 慌てずご準備ください。掲示で迷う部分があれば、お入りになる前にお尋ねくださいね。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take your time getting ready. If any part of the notice is unclear, please ask before entering. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: チェックインのご予約を確認いたします。お名前と予約の案内を拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll check your reservation for check-in. May I see your name and reservation information?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ名前で二つの確認メールがあります。取り直したつもりですが、どちらを見せるべきか分からなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 取り直し前後の確認メールが二つあり提示する物が不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two confirmation emails under the same name. I thought I'd rebooked, but now I'm not sure which one to show.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have two confirmation emails from before and after rebooking and do not know which to show. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約番号で照合します。こちらは取消しの記載があり、もう一方には今夜から二泊とあります。ご予定も二泊でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check by reservation number. This one says canceled, and the other says two nights starting tonight. Is your plan also two nights?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二泊です。古いほうは一泊だったので、そちらを残してしまいました。今夜から二泊の番号で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定は二泊で古い一泊メールを残したと説明し二泊番号での照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, two nights. The old one was for one night, and I'd kept that email. Please check using the number for two nights from tonight.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your plan is two nights and you kept the old one-night email, and request a check using the two-night number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二泊の予約で確認できました。この案内では食事を含まない内容です。ご認識と合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've confirmed the two-night reservation. This information says meals are not included. Does that match your understanding?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 朝食も付くと思っていたので違っていました。追加の案内を聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 朝食付きという思い違いに気づき追加案内を聞いてから決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: It doesn't, because I thought breakfast was included. I'd like to hear the information about adding it before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you realized you were mistaken about breakfast being included and want to decide after hearing about adding it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追加の条件と料金は別にお伝えします。今の段階では食事を付ける変更はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain the conditions and charges for adding it separately. We haven't changed the booking to include meals at this stage.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、食事の追加はまだ保留でお願いします。先に部屋の予約だけを確かめ、費用を混ぜないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食事追加を保留し部屋予約と費用を先に分けて確かめたいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then please keep the addition of meals on hold. I'd like to confirm just the room reservation first and avoid mixing up the costs.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request that adding meals be put on hold and that the room reservation and costs be checked separately first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の二泊の内容と、検討中の食事を分けて書きます。不要になった旧メールにも取消しの印を付けておけますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll write the current two-night booking separately from the meals you're considering. You can also mark the old email you no longer need as canceled.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 旧メールは取消しのフォルダーへ移します。二泊の手続きを進め、朝食の説明は後で別に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧メールを取消フォルダーへ移し二泊手続きを進め朝食説明は別に聞くと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll move the old email to the canceled folder. I'll proceed with the two-night check-in and ask about breakfast separately later.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to move the old email to the canceled folder, proceed with the two-night process, and hear about breakfast separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。予約の内容をそろえてからご案内いたします。ご滞在中も分からない点はフロントへどうぞ。ごゆっくりお過ごしください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll organize the booking details before guiding you. During your stay, please ask the front desk about anything unclear too. Enjoy a relaxing stay. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りをご希望ですか。お決まりの品はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like takeaway? Have you decided what you'd like?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: サンドイッチと焼き菓子を一つずつ考えています。別の用事を済ませてから帰るので、持ち歩きが長くなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: サンドイッチと焼菓子各一個を希望するが寄り道で持歩きが長くなると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm considering one sandwich and one baked treat. I'll go home after finishing another errand, so I may carry them around for quite a while.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want one sandwich and one baked treat but will carry them for a long time because of another stop. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持ち歩く時間に合わせた保管は、商品ごとの案内を見てお選びください。サンドイッチにはこちらの注意書きがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please choose after reading each product's storage guidance for the time you'll carry it. The sandwich has these precautions.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この注意を読むと、用事の間どう保管するか決めていない私には難しそうです。サンドイッチは今回は外します。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保管方法を決めていないため注意書きを踏まえサンドイッチを外す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Reading these precautions, it seems difficult because I haven't decided how to store it during my errand. I'll leave out the sandwich this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Based on the precautions, remove the sandwich because you have not decided how to store it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: かしこまりました。焼き菓子はこの二種類がございます。お選びになる前に表示もご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. We have these two kinds of baked treats. You can read their labels before choosing too.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの丸いほうの表示を読みたいです。贈り物ではなく自分用なので、飾りの包装は要りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 丸い焼菓子の表示を読み自分用で飾り包装は不要と頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to read the label on this round one. It's for me, not a gift, so I don't need decorative wrapping.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to read the round baked treat's label and say it is for yourself and needs no decorative wrapping. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自分用の包装ですね。丸い品を一つ、簡単な袋でまとめる内容でよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Wrapping for your own use, then. Is one round item in a simple bag what you'd like?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つでお願いします。会計する前に、受け取る場所がこのカウンターのままか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一つで確定し会計前に受取り場所が同じカウンターか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: One, please. Before I pay, please tell me whether I collect it at this same counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm one item and ask before paying whether collection is at the same counter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: このご注文は会計後、同じカウンターでお渡しします。お呼びしたときに品数をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll hand over this order at this same counter after payment. When we call you, please check the number of items.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会計後ここで一つ受け取ります。持ち帰ってからも、この品の表示を残しておきたいので袋に入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会計後ここで一つ受け取ると確認し商品表示も袋に残してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll collect one here after paying. I'd like to keep this item's label after taking it home too, so please put it in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will collect one here after payment and ask for the product label to be kept in the bag too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示を確認できるようお渡しします。品数は丸い焼き菓子一つです。ご利用ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll hand it over so you can check the label. The quantity is one round baked treat. Thank you for your custom. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 応援の方ですね。作業の担当と通路を確認してから、職長へつなぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here to help out, right? I'll check your work assignment and the passageways before connecting you with the foreman.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は初参加です。運搬の補助と聞きましたが、手元の図では作業場所への道が一本しか見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初参加で運搬補助と聞いたが図では通路が一本しか分からないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's my first day here. I was told I'd assist with carrying things, but on the diagram I have I can only find one route to the work area.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain it is your first time and you were told to assist with transport, but can identify only one passage on the diagram. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その図の日付はいつでしょうか。通路の一部が変更されているので、古い図と同じとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: What date is that diagram? Part of the passageway has changed, so it may not be the same as the old diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週の日付です。この柵の内側を抜けるように見えますが、そこを近道として使う判断はしないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図が先週版と答え柵内を近道に使う判断をせず確認に残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's dated last week. It looks as though the route goes inside this fence, but I won't decide to use it as a shortcut.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that the diagram is last week's and leave entry inside the fence for confirmation rather than deciding to use it as a shortcut. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入る前に確認する必要があります。新しい図の受取り先と、今日の職長をこちらで確かめます。担当業務の説明は受けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to check before entering. We'll confirm where to get the new diagram and who today's foreman is. Have your duties been explained?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 運ぶ場所はまだ聞いていません。そばにある台車を使ってよいかも、担当の人に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運搬先と手元の台車を使えるか未確認なので担当へ聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't been told where to carry things yet. I'd also like to ask the person in charge whether I may use the cart nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the transport destination and permission to use the nearby cart are unconfirmed and you want to ask the person in charge. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 台車も含め、使う道具と運搬範囲を職長と照らし合わせてください。機械の運転は、運搬補助という言葉だけで引き受けるものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the tools to be used, including the cart, and the transport area with the foreman. You shouldn't agree to operate machinery just because the job was described as transport assistance.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 運搬の補助と機械操作は分けます。もし通路に物が倒れかけているのを見つけたら、どこへ知らせますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運搬補助と機械操作を区別し倒れかけの物を発見した場合の報告先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll distinguish transport assistance from operating machinery. If I find something about to fall into the passageway, where should I report it?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish transport assistance from machinery operation and ask where to report something you find about to fall. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 危険に近づかず、現場で決めた連絡先へ位置と見た状態を伝えます。自分で直しに入る判断とは分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Stay away from the danger and tell the contact designated at the site the location and condition you saw. Keep that separate from deciding to go in and fix it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い図は確認前に使わず、新しい通路と運ぶ範囲を職長に聞きます。気づいた異常は場所を添えて報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧図を使わず職長へ新通路と範囲を確認し異常は位置付きで報告するとまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't use the old diagram before checking, and I'll ask the foreman about the new passageway and the area for carrying things. I'll report anything unusual I notice with its location.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize that you will not use the old diagram, will check the new passageway and transport area with the foreman, and will report abnormalities with their locations. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その確認事項を職長へ引き継ぎます。まだ担当が不明なまま作業へ入らず、こちらでお待ちください。それでは、いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass those points to check on to the foreman. Don't start work while your assignment is still unclear; please wait here. Excuse me for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みのご相談でしょうか。お手元の用紙を先に確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss a transfer? I'll check the papers you have first.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を払いたいのですが、前の案内と今月届いた紙で支店名が違います。どちらを使えばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃の旧案内と今月の紙で支店名が違うためどちらを使うか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to pay my rent, but the branch name differs between the old instructions and the paper I received this month. Which should I use?
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult about which to use because the branch name differs between the old rent instructions and this month's paper. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当行だけでは家賃の正しい振込先を決められません。新しい紙は、変更理由や発行元も確かめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Our bank alone can't determine the correct rent-transfer destination. Can you also check the reason for the change and issuer on the new paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 発行元の名前はありますが、変更理由までは書かれていません。前と同じ受取人のように見えても、決めつけないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発行元はあるが変更理由は不明で受取人が似ていても断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: The issuer's name is there, but the reason for the change isn't written. Even if it looks like the same recipient as before, I shouldn't assume it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the issuer is listed but the reason for the change is unknown, and you will not assume the recipient is the same because the names look similar. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取人名、支店、口座の種類と番号を、支払い先へ確認してから照合しましょう。確認の前に実行は進めないでおけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the recipient's name, branch, account type, and number with the payee, then compare them. You can refrain from executing the transfer before checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いったん振込は止めておきます。管理会社に聞くとき、この二枚の違いを全部伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 振込実行を保留し管理会社へ二枚の相違を全て伝えたいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put the transfer on hold for now. When I ask the management company, I'd like to explain all the differences between these two papers.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put execution of the transfer on hold and say you want to tell the management company all the differences between the two papers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、二枚の内容と届いた時点を区別してお話しください。手数料も、選ぶ方法や条件が決まってから確認する項目です。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, distinguish the contents of the two papers and when each arrived as you explain. The fee is also something to check after the chosen method and conditions are settled.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は振込先も方法も未確定なので、手数料込みの額まで決まったとは考えないことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 振込先と方法が決まらないため手数料込み額も未確定と理解を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: Since neither the transfer destination nor method is settled yet, I won't think the amount including the fee has been determined either.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show you understand that the fee-inclusive amount is also undecided because the destination and method are unsettled. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その理解で結構です。確認が取れた際は、受取人名も数字の欄とは別に照合してからお申し出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's correct. Once you have confirmation, check the recipient's name separately from the numerical fields too before speaking to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新旧の紙を分けて持ち帰り、管理会社の回答をメモします。受取人名と番号がそろってから、振込方法も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新旧案内を持ち帰り回答をメモし名義と番号を確かめてから方法を再相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the old and new papers home separately and note the management company's reply. Once I've checked both the account name and number, I'll ask about the transfer method too.
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take the old and new instructions home, note the reply, and consult again about the method after checking the account name and number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は振込を実行せず、用紙をお返しします。確認した内容をお持ちになって、改めてご相談ください。ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-043-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: We won't execute a transfer today, and I'll return your papers. Please bring the information you've confirmed and consult us again. Thank you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 購入前の座席確認ですね。今選んでいる席について、ご希望と違う点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're checking seats before buying, right? Is anything about the seats currently selected different from what you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で乗ります。この二つの席は番号が続いているので隣だと思いましたが、図では通路を挟んでいるように見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の席番号が連続でも図では通路を挟むように見えると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two of us will travel. I thought these two seats were next to each other because their numbers are consecutive, but the diagram looks as if there's an aisle between them.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that although the two seat numbers are consecutive, the diagram appears to show an aisle between them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この座席図では通路を挟む配置ですね。通路越しでよいですか、それとも同じ側で並ぶ席をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this seating diagram, they are across the aisle. Is that all right, or would you prefer seats next to each other on the same side?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ側で並びたいです。同行する母が説明を聞き取りにくいので、近くで話せる席を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 説明を聞き取りにくい母と話せるよう同じ側で並ぶ席を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: We'd like to sit next to each other on the same side. My mother, who is traveling with me, has difficulty hearing explanations, so I'm looking for seats where we can talk close together.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request adjacent seats on the same side so you can talk with your mother, who has difficulty hearing explanations. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の候補には同じ側に並ぶ空席が表示されていません。別の出発便も候補にしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The current option doesn't show any vacant adjacent seats on the same side. Shall we consider other departures too?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少し出発が遅くなっても構いません。今の便を支払う前に、並べる席がある別の便を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 少し遅い便でもよいので支払い前に並ぶ空席の別便を探してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: A slightly later departure is fine. Before paying for this departure, I'd like to see another one with adjacent seats available.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to look for another departure with adjacent vacant seats before paying, even if it leaves a little later. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では未購入の選択を戻して、次の候補を照会します。窓側を必須にする必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I'll go back from the unpurchased selection and search for the next option. Does a window seat need to be a requirement?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 窓側より二人が並ぶことを優先します。別々の席を取って、後でほかの人と替われることは前提にしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓側より隣席を優先し他客との席交換を前提にしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sitting together is more important than a window seat. I won't book separate seats assuming we can swap with other passengers later.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say adjacent seats take priority over a window seat and you will not assume other passengers can swap seats. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その条件で探します。候補が出たら、列車と日付に加えて座席図もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll search with those conditions. When an option appears, please check the seating diagram as well as the train and date.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 候補の便と日付が合い、同じ側で並ぶ配置だと確認できたときに買います。まだ元の席の購入は進めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 便・日付・座席図を確認するまで元の席は購入しないよう求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll buy when I confirm that the departure and date are right and the seats are adjacent on the same side. Please don't purchase the original seats yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask not to purchase the original seats until you have checked the departure, date, and seating diagram. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 元の席は購入せず、条件を変えた照会から承ります。確認後にお選びください。よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I won't purchase the original seats; we'll begin by searching with the revised conditions. Please choose after checking. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計を終えた後の書類について、お声かけいただいたのですね。どうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've asked about the documents after payment, I understand. What's the matter?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この封筒の領収書に、自分と違う名前があります。職場に出す前に気づきました。ほかの人の書類かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書の氏名が自分と違い別人の書類かもしれないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The receipt in this envelope has a name different from mine. I noticed before submitting it to my workplace. It may be someone else's document.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the receipt has a different name from yours and may belong to someone else. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここで内容を広げずに、会計担当へ確認を引き継ぎます。ご自身の受付番号がわかるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Without spreading out the contents here, I'll pass the check on to the payment staff. Do you have something showing your own reception number?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の受付票はこちらです。領収書の名前を自分で書き直すのではなく、受け取った状態で確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の受付票を示し領収書を書き換えず受領時の状態で確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's my reception slip. Rather than rewriting the name on the receipt myself, I'd like it checked exactly as I received it.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your reception slip and request a check of the receipt as received, without rewriting it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま会計担当におつなぎします。職場へは、領収書だけを提出するよう指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll connect you with the payment staff as it is. Has your workplace specified that you must submit only a receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 職場の連絡には「受診を確認できるもの」としかありません。正しい領収書に替わっても、それで足りるかは職場に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場の受診確認書類の指定が曖昧で正しい領収書で足りるか職場に聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The workplace message only says 'something confirming the medical visit.' Even after it's replaced with the correct receipt, I'll ask my workplace whether that is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the workplace's specification for proof of a medical visit is unclear and you will ask whether the correct receipt is enough. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、書類の取り違えの確認と、提出先が求める書類の確認は別です。診断書が必要なら担当へ改めてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, checking a document mix-up and checking what documents the recipient requires are separate matters. If a medical certificate is needed, please consult the staff again.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今ここで診断書も申し込むのはやめておきます。まず領収書を照合し、職場が必要とする書類名を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診断書を追加申請せず領収書照合と職場の必要書類名確認を先にすると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't apply for a medical certificate here now too. First I want to have the receipt checked and find out the name of the document my workplace needs.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to apply additionally for a medical certificate, prioritizing checking the receipt and the name of the document the workplace requires. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計担当に、受付票との照合をお願いしたいというご希望を伝えます。この封筒もそのままお持ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the payment staff that you'd like them to compare it with your reception slip. Could you also take this envelope as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 封筒ごと持って行きます。氏名が違う書類を職場へ送ったり、写真に撮って転送したりはせず、担当の確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒ごと会計担当へ持参し異なる氏名の書類を職場へ共有せず確認を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the whole envelope. I won't send documents with a different name to my workplace or photograph and forward them; I'll wait for the staff's check.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the envelope to the payment staff, not share documents with a different name with your workplace, and wait for verification. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では会計担当へご案内します。こちらの書類はそちらで確認してもらいましょう。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll guide you to the payment staff. Let's have them check these documents there. Please take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このスープの裏側をご覧ですね。どの表示についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the back of this soup. Which information would you like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 作り方に「薄める」とありますが、一袋がそのまま一食分なのかと思っていました。原材料も小さくて読み切れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄める表示と一袋一食という理解の違いを尋ね原材料も読めていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The preparation instructions say 'dilute,' but I thought one packet was one meal as it was. The ingredients are also too small for me to have finished reading them.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the dilution instruction and your understanding of one packet as one meal, and say you have not read all the ingredients either. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここには濃縮タイプとあり、作り方の説明が別にあります。原材料の欄で特に確認したいものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It says concentrated here, and the preparation instructions are separate. Is there anything in particular you'd like to check in the ingredients section?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 乳のアレルギーがあります。表の写真に牛乳が見えなくても、乳成分が含まれていないとは判断できないので、該当箇所を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乳アレルギーを伝え写真で判断せず乳成分表示の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a milk allergy. Even if milk isn't visible in the photo on the front, I can't judge that it contains no milk ingredients, so please point out the relevant section.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention your milk allergy and ask where the milk-ingredient information is, rather than judging by the photo. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この欄には「乳成分を含む」と記載されています。私から、お客様が食べられるという判断はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: This section says 'contains milk ingredients.' I can't make the judgment that you can eat it.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その表示があるなら、この商品を試しに飲むことはしません。別の商品も、見た目だけで選び直さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乳成分の表示を受け試飲せず別商品も外見だけで選ばないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: If it has that label, I won't try drinking this product. I also won't choose another product based only on how it looks.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After seeing the milk-ingredient label, say you will not taste it or choose an alternative by appearance alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不明な点があれば、商品の問い合わせ先の表示をご案内できます。保存方法の欄も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If anything is unclear, I can show you the product's inquiry contact information. Do you need the storage section too?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。買うかどうかとは分けて、未開封と開封後の保存の書き方も控えたいです。問い合わせ先はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入とは別に開封前後の保存欄と問い合わせ先を控えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Separately from whether to buy it, I'd also like to note how storage before and after opening is described. Where is the inquiry contact?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to note the storage information before and after opening and inquiry contact, separately from deciding whether to buy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 問い合わせ先はこちらです。保存欄はこの横で、開封後については下段に続いています。問い合わせの際は、商品名もお手元に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's the inquiry contact. The storage section is beside it, and the part about after opening continues below. When making an inquiry, have the product name ready too.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 商品名、乳成分の表示、保存欄を控えます。今日は購入せず、製造者への質問を整理してからほかの商品も検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品名・乳表示・保存欄を控え購入せず製造者への質問を整理すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the product name, milk-ingredient label, and storage section. I won't buy it today; I'll organize my questions for the manufacturer before considering other products too.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to note the product name, milk label, and storage section, not buy it, and organize questions for the manufacturer. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日はこの商品を購入されないということで承りました。表示の確認にお使いください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I understand you're not buying this product today. Please use this to check the labeling. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗剤の棚で何かお困りですか。手に取った商品を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble at the detergent shelf? May I see the product you've picked up?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この容器入りの洗剤が、すぐ下の値札の値段だと思ったのですが、値札には「詰替用」とあります。別の商品ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 容器入り洗剤の下の値札に詰替用とあるため別商品か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought this detergent in a container cost the price on the label directly below it, but the label says 'refill.' Is it a different product?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether it is a different product because the price label below the container of detergent says refill. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 値札の品名と容量を照らし合わせましょう。お持ちの商品には「本体」とあります。詰替用の袋ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the product name and quantity on the price label. The product you're holding says 'main container.' It isn't the refill pouch.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家には同じ洗剤の容器がありません。安い方の袋だけを買っても、今ほしいものとは違いそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ洗剤の容器を持っていないため袋だけでは用途と合わないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't have a container for this same detergent at home. Buying only the cheaper pouch doesn't seem to be what I need now.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not have a container for the same detergent, so the pouch alone would not suit your purpose. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では本体の表示を探します。この棚の端に、本体の品名と容量が一致する値札があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's find the main-container label. At the end of this shelf, there's a price label matching its product name and quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この値札が容器入りの方ですね。目立つ数字の横にある小さい文字は、税込みかどうかの表示ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本体の値札を確認し小さい文字が税込み表示か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is the label for the one in a container. Are the small words beside the prominent number saying whether tax is included?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the main-container price label and ask whether the small print indicates tax inclusion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この値札では、税込みの金額がこちらに書かれています。詰替用の数字と混ぜず、本体の方で比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: On this price label, the tax-inclusive amount is written here. Compare the main-container prices without mixing them with the refill figures.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 税込みの本体価格で比べます。容量の大きい本体もありますが、置く棚が狭いので小さい方を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本体の税込み価格を比べ置き場所が狭いため小さい本体を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll compare the tax-inclusive prices of the main containers. There's a larger main container too, but my storage shelf is narrow, so I'd like the smaller one.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare tax-inclusive main-container prices and request the smaller container because the storage space is narrow. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小さい本体を選ばれるのですね。会計でも、品名が詰替用ではなく本体になっているか確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You're choosing the small main container, then. At checkout too, you can check that the product name is the main container and not the refill.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さい本体を一つ持って行きます。レジでは本体の品名と税込みの表示を見て、違っていたら支払う前に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小さい本体を一つ選びレジの品名と税込み表示が違えば支払い前に尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take one small main container. At the till, I'll look at the product name and tax-inclusive display, and if they're different, I'll ask before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will choose one small main container and ask before paying if the till's product name or tax-inclusive display differs. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本体と詰替用は別の商品としてご確認ください。こちらの小さい本体で承りました。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the main container and refill as separate products. We have your choice as this small main container. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の予約をご希望ですね。ご用件がわかるものをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to book a consultation. Do you have anything showing what it's about?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通知が二通あります。どちらも同じ住所に届いたので、一つ予約すれば両方とも相談できると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所が同じため二通の通知を一予約で相談できると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two notices. They both came to the same address, so I thought I could discuss both in one appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought two notices could be discussed in one appointment because the address was the same. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 件名と発行部署が違いますね。同じ担当でよいか、二つの用件として確認します。特に先に聞きたいのはどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The subjects and issuing departments differ. I'll check them as two matters to see whether the same person can handle them. Which do you particularly want to ask about first?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 回答を求められている方を先にしたいです。もう一通は説明会の案内なので、申込みが必要かを別に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 回答が必要な通知を優先し説明会の申込要否は別に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to prioritize the one requiring a reply. The other is an information-session notice, so I'd like to ask separately whether I need to sign up.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Prioritize the notice requiring a response and say you want to check information-session registration separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 回答の相談と説明会の申込み確認ですね。ご本人だけで相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: So, consultation about a reply and checking information-session registration. Will you consult alone?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日本語が得意な友人が付き添う予定ですが、その友人が正式な通訳として対応できるとは言えません。言語の支援を別に相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の付き添いを正式通訳と同一視せず別の言語支援を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: A friend who speaks Japanese well is planning to accompany me, but I can't say they can act as an official interpreter. Can I discuss language support separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not equate your friend's accompaniment with official interpreting; ask about separate language support. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 支援の方法と手配の可否を担当へ確認します。希望する言語と、連絡を受けられる方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the staff about support methods and whether arrangements can be made. Please tell me your preferred language and how you can receive contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベトナム語を希望します。仕事中は電話に出られないので、折り返すための連絡方法も決めておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベトナム語を希望し勤務中は電話に出られないため折返し方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd prefer Vietnamese. I can't answer the phone at work, so I'd also like to decide how to make contact to call back.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request Vietnamese and discuss a way to return contact because you cannot answer calls while working. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望も伝えます。予約の確定や支援の手配が済んだという意味ではないので、担当からの案内で日時と対象の用件を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass that preference on too. This doesn't mean the appointment is confirmed or support has been arranged, so please check the date, time, and matter covered in the staff member's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は希望を伝えた段階ですね。回答の相談がどの予約に当たるか、説明会は別申込みかを、日時と一緒に確かめてから予定を空けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約は未確定と理解し相談対象・説明会申込・日時を確認後に予定を調整すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: So at this stage I've only conveyed my preferences. I'll make time in my schedule after confirming which appointment covers the reply consultation, whether the information session needs a separate registration, and the date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show you understand the appointment is unconfirmed and say you will adjust your schedule after checking the consultation topic, information-session registration, and date and time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二通を区別したメモをお渡しします。日時と支援が確定したら控えてください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you a note distinguishing the two notices. Once the date, time, and support are confirmed, write them down. Take care on your way home.
